methods.note: The paper's method is a 3D stack with TSV-coupled cache layers, HotSpot transient simulation, gem5/McPAT power traces, a closed-loop fuzzy DVFS controller with a runtime threshold, and Algorithm 1 bank gating (PDF pp. 3-9). The extraction itself lists these as essential mismatches, yet its experiment block says kind custom_2d_steady. Calling any 2D steady run a reproduction is unsupported. The textual method details (9 rules, 3 triangular sets, mean-of-maxima, T = 2M cycles, 3%) match pp. 6-9.

code.note: No code repository, supplement, or pinned asset exists (assets list is empty). The only linked URLs are specbench.org and the CC BY license, and neither is a research artifact. The gem5, McPAT, CACTI and HotSpot configs and the controller implementation are not available.

parameters.note: Verified in text: 4 cores, 3 L2 layers, 16 banks per layer, 4 banks per zone, 256 KB banks, 32 KB L1 I and D, T = 2M cycles, 3%, e range [0,3], dT range [-1.5,1.5]. The e(n) unit (degC) and the dT unit are inferred, not stated. Decisive thermal parameters (Ramb, Rv, C, Tamb, runtime threshold values, frequency/voltage levels, power values) are not published. Whether 3.5 degC, 0.5 degC and 3 degC apply to mem2 specifically or to mem2 and com2 together is unclear.

config.note: No HotSpot config (layers, materials, grid, heat sink, package), no floorplan file, and no gem5/McPAT/CACTI configs. Figure 1 is schematic with no dimensions. The runtime threshold of ref. 19 is not given numerically. No Studio config is pinned, so no 2D scenario match can be checked.

data.note: No block coordinates or per-block mem2 power exist, so floorplan and power_rows are empty and no same-scenario power can be matched to any block. Figure 6(a) was seen only through pdftotext axis labels. The curves were not visually inspected as an image, and no values are tabulated, so the observable is null. Axis ticks 75-81 degC and 200-450 ms come from a text layer only.

findings.reason: The experiment is declared custom_2d_steady while steady_2d_relevant is false and the extraction lists 3D, transient and closed-loop control as essential mismatches. It also has an empty floorplan and no power. This is an internal contradiction and would be a false 2D reproduction.
No block names, geometry or same-scenario per-block power are published or pinned. Any generated 2D shelf coordinates or constant power rows would be illustrative assumptions, not paper data.
